description: Mike Reilly stated: “I am extremely proud to announce the United Federation of Teachers (UFT) & New York State United Teachers (NYSUT) have endorsed my candidacy for the South Shore State Assembly. I am truly thankful to have the support of our teachers. I will continue to advocate and fight for the resources they need to support our students, families and school communities!”
